title: ledger service environment
description: Environment of the ledger service (src/main.ts). At least one provider block (LEDGER_XPUB, BTCPAY_URL, CARD_API_URL or LEDGER_FAKE_PROVIDER) is required. Values are strings, as in any environment. Secrets (marked) are injected from the secret store, never committed.

HOST.description: Bind address. The service sits behind the fleet edge; do not bind 0.0.0.0 without it.

LEDGER_DB_PATH.description: SQLite file (store sqlite:ledger). Unset = in-memory store (dev only; state is lost on restart).

LEDGER_API_KEYS_JSON.description: Secret: services/ledger/api-keys. JSON array of @bsh/edge ApiKeyRecord {id, hash (sha256 hex of the key), env, scopes:["ledger"|"ledger:admin"], ownerId:<product slug>}. Keys themselves are never stored.

LEDGER_KEY_ENV.description: Only keys of this environment are accepted.

LEDGER_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated CIDRs of proxies we run; X-Forwarded-For is only honoured from them.

LEDGER_XPUB.description: Secret: services/ledger/xpub. ACCOUNT-level extended PUBLIC key (zpub/xpub for mainnet, vpub/tpub for signet/testnet). Private keys are refused.

LEDGER_ADDRESS_TYPE.description: BIP84 or BIP86 derivation of receive addresses.

LEDGER_ESPLORA_URL.description: Esplora / mempool.space-compatible API base (e.g. https://mempool.space/api or the fleet's self-hosted instance).

LEDGER_CONFIRMATIONS.description: Confirmations before an on-chain payment is credited. 0 accepts unconfirmed non-RBF transactions.

LEDGER_ONCHAIN_PROVIDER.description: Which provider serves method=onchain when both the xpub watcher and BTCPay are configured.

BTCPAY_URL.description: BTCPay Server base URL (tailnet admin host; the Greenfield API is not on the public checkout vhost - ADR-089).

BTCPAY_API_KEY.description: Secret: services/ledger/btcpay/api-key. Greenfield key limited to invoice create/view and non-approved pull payments on this store.

CARD_FIAT_MINOR_PER_BTC.description: Fixed quote in minor units per BTC (e.g. 6500000 = $65,000.00). Replace with a rate source before production card volume.

LEDGER_FAKE_PROVIDER.description: Dev only: register the FakeProvider (serves every method, never settles by itself).
